scripts.dev:web: node init && pnpm --filter web run dev
scripts.dev:backend: node init && pnpm --filter backend run dev
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: node init && pnpm --filter web run build
scripts.build:web: node init && pnpm --filter web run build
scripts.build:backend: node init && pnpm --filter backend run build
scripts.tsc: pnpm --filter web run tsc && pnpm --filter backend run tsc
